question: A car moving at $20$ m/s towards a wall sounds its horn of frequency $400$ Hz. The frequency of the echo heard by the driver is (speed of sound $= 340$ m/s)
solution:
The wall receives $400 \times \dfrac{340}{320}$ and reflects it as a stationary source; the moving driver hears
$$f'' = 400 \times \frac{340 + 20}{340 - 20} = 400 \times \frac{360}{320} = 450\ \text{Hz}$$
